sickLeave.law: Illinois paid leave for all workers
sickLeave.capKind: hours accrued and used each year
sickLeave.note: Effective 2024: paid leave for any reason, 1 hour per 40 hours worked, up to 40 hours a year (or front-loaded). Chicago and Cook County have their own ordinances. Needs checking.
